<div class="dmz-hatnote"><translate><!--T:17--> For the young Trunks of the Buu Saga, see [[Special:MyLanguage/Kid Trunks|Kid Trunks]].</translate></div>
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Trunks''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who waits at his time machine, [[Special:MyLanguage/Trunks' Ship|Trunks' Ship]], on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. He teaches ki skills, four ki attacks and two strikes, and runs the '''Precision''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|training minigame]]. He trains anyone, whatever their alignment.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
Trunks waits at [[Special:MyLanguage/Trunks' Ship|Trunks' Ship]], which generates once per world in land biomes. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 4 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Trunks' Ship#Finding it|Trunks' Ship]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques == <!--T:9-->
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
<!--T:10-->
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], Ki Boost, [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Protection|Ki Protection]]
* '''Ki attacks:''' Burning Attack, [[Special:MyLanguage/Heat Dome Attack|Heat Dome Attack]], Galick Gun, Ki Barrage
* '''Strike attacks:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Shining Sword Attack|Shining Sword Attack]], Meteor
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:11-->
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill.
</translate>

<translate>
== Training == <!--T:12-->
</translate>
{{Main|Training Minigames}}
<translate>
<!--T:13-->
Trunks' '''Train''' option offers a Shadow Clone to spar with and the '''Precision''' minigame: click each circle the moment its shrinking ring meets it. Play it from Trunks 3 times reaching level 5 to learn it; after that you can replay it from the Minigames tab of your menu, and starting it from Trunks pays a +25% mentor bonus.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:15-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]] quest 16, ''The Time Machine'': find Trunks' Ship.
</translate>

<translate>
== As a tournament fighter == <!--T:18-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:19-->
'''Future Trunks''' and '''Future Trunks (Super Saiyan)''', NPC fighters separate from the master, can be drawn as contenders in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]]. A bracket has at most one of them. The young Trunks who fights in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]] is [[Special:MyLanguage/Kid Trunks|Kid Trunks]].
</translate>
